syllabus_topics: I. INTRODUCTION TO TOPOGRAPHY: Notions of Geodesy, Topography and Cartography. Coordinate transformation. Error theory. General topographic instrumentation.

II. PLANIMETRIC METHODS: Planimetry instrumentation: total station. Measurement and representation of angles and distances. Area calculation. Radiation method: simple and compound. Traverse method: closed and enclosed. Direct and inverse intersections. Error compensation. Layouts. Digital terrain models. Triangulation.
III. ALTIMETRIC METHODS: Instrumentation: levels. Closed and enclosed traverses. Error compensation. Layout of horizontal levels.
IV. PHOTOGRAMMETRY, GNSS AND GEOGRAPHIC INFORMATION SYSTEMS: Photogrammetry. GNSS: Introduction, fundamentals, constellations. Geographic Information Systems.
assessment_rules: Attendance to field practices is mandatory. Evaluation is based on field practice reports, practical exercises, a final project, attendance and participation, and a theoretical-practical final exam. No specific grading formula or resit details are provided.
